result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the bottom navigation appears to have an unintended dark horizontal line overlapping the icons.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal line runs across the bottom navigation area, overlapping the search and middle navigation icons. This looks like a rendering or layout artifact and makes the nav bar appear broken.
issues.suggestion: Check the bottom navigation selected-state indicator, divider, or gesture/home indicator styling. Ensure any active indicator is correctly positioned and does not overlap the icons.
